title: CROW: Benchmarking Commonsense Reasoning in Real-World Tasks
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark for commonsense reasoning in real-world NLP tasks. While it includes a 'Safety detection' task, this is framed around practical safety and avoiding physical harm, not broader ethical, moral, or religious considerations. The paper also briefly mentions 'annotation artifacts and biases' in its limitations, but this refers to data quality of the benchmark itself, not a core component of evaluating LLM bias, faith, or ethics.
